## Install

Download `NX9-{{VERSION}}.dmg` below, open it and drag NX9 into Applications.  To update, replace the old copy;  your settings are kept.  Needs macOS 13 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel.

NX9 is signed by Functional Development LLC and notarized by Apple.

SHA-256 of `NX9-{{VERSION}}.dmg`:  `{{SHA256}}`
